verdict.rationale: Sending-domain authentication is a fair axis for an email marketing platform, so it applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain connection, or guided DNS setup and verification. Setting a sender name and from-address is a related but different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification
